metaDescription: Order custom Bulwark nursing scrubs in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Durable, FR-rated options for healthcare teams. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Bulwark nursing scrubs bring flame-resistant protection to healthcare environments where safety is paramount. Unlike standard scrubs, Bulwark's FR-rated fabrics meet NFPA 2112 standards, making them ideal for hospitals, clinics, and labs with electrical or flash fire hazards. Choose from styles like the YM9054 or YM9254 in navy or pewter, and add your facility's logo with embroidery or screen printing. Perfect for safety managers equipping teams with both compliance and comfort.
